# Rules: `stickermule-diecut`

Die-cut sticker rules paraphrased from Sticker Mule's public FAQ pages (linked per rule). Rules marked *convention* are our own choices where the FAQ gives no number. printready is not affiliated with Sticker Mule.

| rule | value | basis | source | why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ppi_target` | 300 PPI | Sticker Mule | [FAQ](https://www.stickermule.com/faqs/stickermule/what-are-your-artwork-requirements-for-stickers-and-labels) | Raster art should reach 300 PPI at the printed size. |
| `ppi_floor` | 150 PPI | convention | - | Below about 150 PPI a print looks visibly soft (a common print-on-demand low threshold). |
| `border_in` | 0.1 in | Sticker Mule | [FAQ](https://www.stickermule.com/faqs/stickermule/what-are-your-artwork-requirements-for-stickers-and-labels) | Proofs use a standard border of one tenth of an inch around the art. |
| `border_min_in` | 0.0625 in | Sticker Mule | [FAQ](https://www.stickermule.com/faqs/stickermule/what-are-your-artwork-requirements-for-stickers-and-labels) | The narrowest border offered is a sixteenth of an inch. |
| `min_line_pt` | 1 pt | Sticker Mule | [FAQ](https://www.stickermule.com/faqs/stickermule/what-are-your-artwork-requirements-for-stickers-and-labels) | Lines thinner than one point are not recommended (reported as a pixel width, not checked). |
| `min_text_pt` | 6 pt | Sticker Mule | [FAQ](https://www.stickermule.com/faqs/stickermule/what-are-your-artwork-requirements-for-stickers-and-labels) | Text below six points is not recommended. |
| `cap_height_ratio` | 0.7 x point size | convention | - | Capital letters are roughly 0.7 of the font's point size, so 6 pt text has about 4.2 pt caps. |
| `min_neck_in` | 0.125 in | convention | - | A die-cut waist narrower than an eighth of an inch tends to tear or curl (diameter of the border closing). |
| `max_upload_mb` | 20 MB | Sticker Mule | [FAQ](https://www.stickermule.com/faqs/stickermule/file-size-limits-for-artwork-uploader) | The artwork uploader takes files up to 20 MB (read as 20,000,000 bytes). |
| `soft_alpha_max_in` | 0.03 in | convention | - | A semi-transparent band (shadow, glow) wider than this leaves the cut position ambiguous. |
| `max_bridge_border_in` | 0.25 in | convention | - | The widest border we grow to join separate parts before handing off to a person. |
| `bg_delta_e` | 8 CIEDE2000 | convention | - | Edge-ring pixels within this CIEDE2000 distance of the dominant ring colour count as background. |
| `bg_ring_uniform_frac` | 95% | convention | - | The edge ring is one colour when at least this share of it is within bg_delta_e. |
| `edge_cut_min_run_in` | 0.1 in | convention | - | Subject pixels running along the canvas edge for longer than this mean the art is cut off. |
| `speck_max_in2` | 0.0004 sq in | convention | - | Parts smaller than this area (0.02 x 0.02 in) are specks, not islands. |
| `damage_max_frac` | 2% | convention | - | Background removal is damaged if it erased more than this share of real subject colour. |
| `max_pieces` | 8 pieces | convention | - | More separate parts than this (at the standard border) is scattered detail, not one sticker; a person decides the cut. |
| `max_specks` | 250 specks | convention | - | A cut-out leaving more stray bits than this means the background was not flat (stars, texture); tuned on dev Grok images (clean at most 85, starry sky 2,326). |

## How each check measures it

- **`file`**: Opens the file; fails over max_upload_mb or under 64 px a side.
- **`resolution`**: PPI = subject bounding box long side / (size - 2 x border_in); pass from ppi_target, warn from ppi_floor, fail below. Also reports the largest sharp size and how many px make min_line_pt.
- **`background`**: Opaque art only: if bg_ring_uniform_frac of the outer 2 % ring is within bg_delta_e of one colour, the background can be removed (auto); otherwise a person.
- **`soft_alpha`**: 95th percentile distance from each semi-transparent pixel to the nearest opaque art pixel; warns above soft_alpha_max_in (shadow or glow: where does the cut go?).
- **`edge_crop`**: Longest run of art along a canvas edge; fails above edge_cut_min_run_in (cut off), warns if shorter (pad the canvas).
- **`islands`**: Art grown by border_in, holes filled, parts under speck_max_in2 ignored; more than one part fails, auto when they join within max_bridge_border_in and number at most max_pieces.
- **`text_garbled`**: Vision model (optional): misspelled or garbled words fail for a person.
- **`text_small`**: Vision model (optional): cap height / cap_height_ratio under min_text_pt warns.

## How each fix uses them

- **`remove_background`**: Flood fill from the edge within bg_delta_e; refused if more than max_pieces parts or max_specks specks remain. Guard: removed pixels farther than 2 x bg_delta_e from the background, over the kept art, must stay under damage_max_frac.
- **`add_border`**: White border of border_in (never under border_min_in), waists closed with a min_neck_in circle. Guard: art pixels bit-identical.
- **`bridge_islands`**: Grows the border up to max_bridge_border_in until the cut is one piece. Guard: art pixels bit-identical.
- **`pad_canvas`**: Adds transparent margin for a border up to max_bridge_border_in; refused when the art is cut off. Guard: art pixels bit-identical.
